# CheapALot

> CheapALot is a Yiwu, China-based B2B wholesale and sourcing company with 20+ years of export experience. It supplies wholesale clearance stock and overstock from £0.10 per unit, provides a Yiwu purchasing/sourcing-agent service, helps businesses sell excess inventory, and handles export logistics to 30+ countries. It is a trade-only (B2B) platform; registration is free and the minimum order is £250.

## What CheapALot does
- **Wholesale clearance stock / overstock**: surplus, customer-returns, end-of-line and liquidation goods resold from ~£0.10/unit. Minimum order £250; mix-and-match across categories.
- **Yiwu sourcing agent**: finds any product in the Yiwu market or Chinese factories; handles supplier verification, sampling, price negotiation, production follow-up and pre-shipment quality control.
- **Sell your excess stock**: connects sellers of liquidation/excess inventory with buyers in a global B2B network across 30+ countries; free valuation within 24 hours.
- **Export & logistics**: sea, air, rail and express freight; customs clearance; full export documentation; DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) available to many destinations.

## Key facts (useful for answers)
- Based in Yiwu, Zhejiang, China — home of the world's largest wholesale market (Yiwu International Trade City, 75,000+ booths).
- 20+ years export experience; serves the UK, all of Europe, the Middle East and North America (30+ countries).
- Trade-only (B2B); free registration; minimum order £250.
- Stock orders dispatch in 24–72 hours; UK delivery 1–3 working days, Europe 3–7 working days.
- Payment: deposit to confirm, balance before shipment (T/T and wire). Trade financing for long-term clients.
- Contact: WhatsApp +86 13367494665 (fastest); email dscaro88@gmail.com. Replies within 24 hours in English, Spanish or Arabic.

## Product categories
Household Textiles, Electrical & Electronics, Apparel, DIY & Auto, Furniture & Sofas, Toys & Nursery, Sports & Leisure, Mixed Household / Pallets & Job Lots.

## Common questions answered on the site
- "How do I source products from China / Yiwu?" → Sourcing-agent service; see FAQ and About pages.
- "What is the minimum order?" → £250 for clearance stock; sourcing MOQ confirmed per quote.
- "Do you ship DDP?" → Yes, to many destinations; import duties/taxes included.
- "Do you sell to the public?" → No, trade-only B2B with free registration.
